title: Revit In-Place Family Exception Governed Fields

entries.name: Exception scope
entries.requirement: Each governed in-place family exception shall identify the project/model scope and affected content.

entries.name: Uniqueness basis
entries.requirement: The exception shall state why the geometry is genuinely unique, contextual, non-repeating, or temporary such that governed reusable content is not appropriate.

entries.name: Reuse assessment
entries.requirement: The exception shall record why a loadable family, group, assembly, or other governed reusable construct cannot reasonably satisfy the requirement.

entries.name: Schedule and tag impact
entries.requirement: The exception shall identify whether the content must be scheduled, tagged, classified, or tracked and how those information requirements are satisfied without manual patching.

entries.name: Rationale
entries.requirement: A concise rationale shall be retained for every material in-place exception used in governed production content.

entries.name: Approval reference
entries.requirement: Where project governance requires approval for an in-place exception, the applicable approval decision or delegated authority shall be traceable.

entries.name: Governance parameter reference
entries.requirement: Where exception identity, rationale, status, or approval is carried in model data, the exact parameters shall come from governed S8 parameter authority rather than ad-hoc text fields.

entries.name: Temporary or permanent status
entries.requirement: The exception shall identify whether the content is temporary or intended to remain in the governed model through delivery.

entries.name: Remediation trigger
entries.requirement: Where an in-place family becomes repeated, reused, scheduled, standardized, or otherwise exceeds its exception basis, conversion to governed reusable content shall be evaluated.

non_promoted_source_content: Source example parameter labels such as Exception Flag, Rationale, and Approver are not promoted as canonical parameter names; exact parameter identities remain S8 registry authority.
No universal approver role is invented where the project BEP/RACI has not assigned one.

provenance.migration_note: Promotes the durable exception evidence needed for restricted in-place family use without inventing parameter names or approval authority.
